name: Library seats
summary: A study floor plan from above (window carrels, the long table, round tables, the stacks): empty seats glow, strangers' seats hold a laptop, friends sit as faces and full tables go dark; tap a seat or let it find one near friends, and save the next seat for a friend for 15 minutes.
useWhen: is there any space up there
anyone at fenwick? save me a seat
how full is the 3rd floor rn
where are you guys sitting in the library
saving one for maya, she's 10 min out
dontUseWhen: the library at night as a building with lit windows (use fenwick-lights)
booking a study room for a fixed time (use meeting-time)
event or arena seats (use concert or ticket tools)

place.description: Group or place, e.g. 'Fenwick 3rd floor regulars'

tables.description: Up to 4 tables, drawn in order: top strip, left, right top, right bottom

strangers.description: Seats taken by people outside the chat

name.description: Their name as in the chat

said.description: What they said, in their words

saving.description: A seat being saved right now, optional
